newsitem.title: UK: Ian Lang not to seek parliamentary re-election.
newsitem.headline: Ian Lang not to seek parliamentary re-election.

text.p: Former cabinet minister Ian Lang announced on Friday he would not seek reelection to parliament.

Lang, President of the Board of Trade and Scottish Secretary in John Major's government, lost his Galloway and Upper Nithsdale seat to Scottish Nationalist Alasdair Morgan in the May 1 general election.

"I will be over 60 by the time of the next general election and I feel that it is time to make way for a younger candidate," Lang told the annual general meeting of his local Conservative Association.
